text:
kelly (Support): heads up — customer reported a spike of 503s + client timeouts to /v1/generate starting ~09:10 UTC. Ticket #7892. They saw retries but still ~30% of requests failing. Not rate-limited.

amar (SRE): looking. any example request-id or gateway log?

kelly (Support): example req id: req_0a7f3c. Gateway log shows upstream returned 503 and an abrupt container restart. snip: `upstream response: 503, reason: upstream process exited (signal 11)`

kelly (Support): customer is calling model=redwood-13b-quant with long context (~18k tokens) and batch_size=8. They say it used to be fine until yesterday after a model rollout.

jin (eng-runtime): SIGSEGV + signal 11 suggests a native crash. Amar, can you get the runner logs and the container exit code? Also need the model binary hash + quantization profile.

ops-bot: [ALERT] hosted-infer/gpu-allocator OOM spike for pool=hosted-a-north-1: metric gpu_memory_failures increased from 2/h to 40/h at 09:08 UTC. container_restart_count for service infer-runner rose by 18 in last 12m.

amar (SRE): grabbed logs from node-7a: `/var/log/infer-runner/runner.log` contains repeated stack traces, then `Killed by SIGSEGV`. Preceding lines show NVML OOM reports: `E GPU 0: memory allocation failed: out of memory` and then `cuda: invalid device pointer` before crash.

amar (SRE): immediate mitigation: 1) enable fallback routing for the customer to redwood-7b-quant, 2) scale their concurrency to 2 and force no-batching for now, 3) cordon node-7a from serving until we have root cause. Who can flip routing?

lia (CS): I'll ask customer if they accept fallback; they prefer no change but are OK with temporary fallback while we investigate. Also raised billing question — they were charged retries; should we issue credit while we triage?

jin (eng-runtime): thanks. For repro can someone run the exact request locally (on internal repro infra) with environment variables matching: `BATCH_SIZE=8 CONTEXT_TOKENS=18000 USE_KV_PREFETCH=1 MODEL=redwood-13b-quant`. Simple curl payload: ```
curl -X POST https://internal-repro:8443/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"redwood-13b-quant","input":"<long prompt repeated>","max_tokens":1024}'
```

kelly (Support): posted the customer's sanitized prompt and request headers in the ticket. Also attached a small heap profile and the gateway trace showing the 503 path.

amar (SRE): additional notes from node: GPU memory usage climbs steadily during KV prefetch, then allocation fails when more than ~86% used. We suspect a regression in KV prefetch memory accounting after the quant swap. Rolling back the recent runtime hotfix (r2026.3.12) removed the immediate crashes on a canary test.

jin (eng-runtime): good find. Can we get core dump + `gdb` backtrace from one of the crashed containers? Also confirm whether the quantization layer introduced a new pinned memory allocation path. If rollback fixes it, plan: revert, run negative tests across long contexts, then reintroduce with increased memory guardrails and improved OOM handling (reject earlier instead of segfault).

amar (SRE): taking node-7a out of rotation now. Revert queued to canary in 2m. If canary passes (no segfaults under load for 15m), we'll push a fix and then gradual rollout.

lia (CS): customer accepted fallback and asked for an ETA on credits. Kelly, please offer temporary credit for impacted window and explain rollback plan.

kelly (Support): will do. Also assigning postmortem once we confirm root cause. Quick note: add alert for `nvml_memory_allocation_failures` with 5-min aggregated rate > 5 for any pool. current alert was too coarse. :thumbsup:

amar (SRE): ack. I'll tighten alerting and add a short-term autoscaler tweak to lower max batch size for hosted-a-north-1 pools until we validate the memory accounting.

jin (eng-runtime): once we have gdb dump, I'll trace the native alloc path. If it's reproable, make a stripped reproducer and run under valgrind/ASAN on a dev GPU.

ops-bot: [ACTION] revert r2026.3.12 -> scheduled canary at 1768010200 by amar.

kelly (Support): thanks team — I'll update ticket #7892 and ping customer when fallback is live.

amar (SRE): will post canary results in this thread. Keep paging if customer still sees 503s after fallback.
